CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.BOARD_PACK_LOG (
    LOG_ID NUMBER AUTOINCREMENT, PERIOD STRING, SCOPE STRING, STAGE STRING, ACTOR STRING,
    COMMENT STRING, SNAPSHOT VARIANT, CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())

SELECT STAGE, ACTOR, COMMENT, SNAPSHOT, TO_VARCHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS AT
      FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.BOARD_PACK_LOG WHERE PERIOD = '' AND SCOPE = 'Group' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, LOG_ID DESC LIMIT 50
